name: agency_sync
description: Mirror persona files from github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents into agency/<division>/<file>.md, verbatim, plus a summary catalog at agency/index.json (division, path, name, description per persona). These are not clanker skills and are never injected into any system prompt — agency-agents ships ~150 personas across 17 divisions, and auto-loading that as always-on context would bloat every turn. This tool only mirrors the corpus locally; a separate picker reads agency/index.json and the model's task to choose which persona (if any) fits. Input: {} syncs every division (dozens of HTTP round trips, can take a while); {"division":"engineering"} scopes to one division for a fast, repeatable check — a scoped sync merges into the existing catalog rather than replacing it, so other divisions' entries survive.
llm_description: Sync agency-agents personas (github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents) verbatim into agency/<division>/<file>.md plus a catalog at agency/index.json. {} = every division; {division} = one division only, merged into the existing catalog. Not clanker skills — nothing here is auto-injected into a prompt.

division.description: Sync only this division's directory (e.g. engineering, marketing, design). Omit to sync every division listed in the source repo's divisions.json.
